ownedContributions.change: Implement strict file.finalize payload {file,uploadId,checksum,sizeBytes} exactly as specified; use accepted Rox2EntityRef/RoxCommand/canonical result types. Define StartUpload, FinalizeUpload, Attach, SignedDownload, DeleteFile DTOs and pure ports against accepted foundation interfaces. Actor is transport input, never body data. ownedContributions.change: Use the common policy/idempotency/revision gateway. StartUpload reserves an actor/workspace-bound staging job. FinalizeUpload reads actual staged object metadata/bytes through the injected object port, verifies checksum, exact byte count and allowed detected MIME, checks current policy, and persists either quarantine or ready state with a receipt/event. risks: Primary file.finalize schema is precise, but secondary operations, MIME/byte policy, checksum algorithm, URL TTL/revoke SLA, parent ACL inheritance and retention/hold policy are not specified numerically in the inspected WP-39 record. Do not infer them from unrelated local/API image limits.
Three existing attachment identities differ: per-session random UUID, Project filename/path and Page HTML/snapshot. A canonical gateway without caller migration would preserve divergence.
Local getFileType defaults unknown files to text and readFileAttachment truncates large text. Shared finalization must not hash truncated/converted bytes as the original object.
STORE_ATTACHMENT may resize images and convert Office files; thumbnails/markdown are separately retained sensitive derivatives and must carry source revision/policy/provenance.

Directory allowlists, sensitive-path blocks and native live-result helpers do not implement authenticated shared ACL. Legacy path reads/writes can bypass a newly added shared endpoint unless cutover is complete.

Direct provider presigned URLs may remain usable until expiry despite server ACL revoke. Select a real enforceable download boundary and prove the bounded contract; do not silently promise immediate revocation.
Static public HTML/snapshot export is a copy, not a revocable private file capability. Embedded private bytes or derived summaries outlive URL revoke unless sharing policy rejects the export.
Blob I/O and PostgreSQL are not one transaction. Missing staging/read-back/reconciliation semantics can leave orphaned objects, false finalized results or duplicate cleanup after timeout/restart.
Deleting a Project currently recursively removes assets; shared detach/delete/retention must account for cross-surface references and legal hold instead of copying local unlink semantics.

No renderer, Task/chat domain implementation, object provider or foundation runtime was inspected under this worker boundary. Their readiness and exact patch symbols must be supplied by lead-owned integration receipts, not inferred from proposed plan names.

Whole-file hashes may become stale during root integration. Report verifier checks current bytes; any mismatch means the affected evidence must be reread and refreshed, not accepted as runtime completion.

Feature completeness includes attention, mentions, activity, agent and offline behavior beyond the four headline assertions; none may be converted to N/A merely because its host foundation is missing.
